concepts.name: Logarithms and floor/ceiling
concepts.gloss: Base-2 logarithm lg n and the integer rounding functions used in bit-length and running-time expressions.

concepts.name: Modular arithmetic
concepts.gloss: Arithmetic on integers where numbers are identified when they differ by a multiple of the modulus.

concepts.name: Prime numbers and prime powers
concepts.gloss: Integers greater than 1 with no proper divisors, their powers, and the notion of pairwise coprime numbers.

concepts.name: Chinese remainder theorem
concepts.gloss: For pairwise coprime moduli, residues modulo each are in bijection with residues modulo their product.

concepts.name: Roots of unity
concepts.gloss: Complex numbers z with z^n=1, expressed as e^{2πik/n}.

concepts.name: Binary representation and bit operations
concepts.gloss: Writing integers in base 2 and combining bits with exclusive-or.

concepts.name: Radix (base-b) representation
concepts.gloss: Writing an integer as a sum of digits times powers of a base.

concepts.name: Schoolbook multiplication and carries
concepts.gloss: The quadratic digit-by-digit multiplication algorithm with carries.

concepts.name: Recursion and recurrences
concepts.gloss: Algorithms that solve a problem through calls on smaller instances, with cost described by a recurrence.

concepts.name: Matrices and linear maps
concepts.gloss: Rectangular arrays of numbers representing linear maps, with product, inverse and invertibility.

concepts.name: Rank of a matrix
concepts.gloss: The dimension of the span of a matrix's columns.

concepts.name: Triangular matrices
concepts.gloss: Square matrices with zero entries above (or below) the diagonal.

concepts.name: Vector spaces and subspaces
concepts.gloss: Sets closed under addition and scaling, and their sub-collections and dimension.

concepts.name: Rational numbers and fields
concepts.gloss: Number systems with addition, multiplication and division, such as the rationals or integers modulo a prime.

concepts.name: Permutations
concepts.gloss: Rearrangements of a finite set of positions.

concepts.name: Multidimensional arrays
concepts.gloss: Data indexed by tuples of coordinates, stored linearly on a tape in some order.

concepts.name: Finite sets and subsets
concepts.gloss: Basic set operations and counting of subsets.

concepts.name: Cyclic groups

concepts.name: Gaussian function
concepts.gloss: The function e^{-x^2} and its rapid decay.

concepts.name: Time and space on tapes
concepts.gloss: Cost of Turing-machine computation measured in steps, including sequential scans of tape contents.

background.summary: An undergraduate computer science reader who knows asymptotic notation, algorithm analysis and recursion, discrete mathematics (modular arithmetic, primes, the Chinese remainder theorem, sets, permutations, binary representation), and first-year linear algebra (matrices, rank, invertibility, subspaces). They know polynomials and complex numbers including roots of unity, and basic multitape Turing machines. They have not met the fast Fourier transform in depth, convolution theory, Gaussian analysis, fixed-point error control, or the research literature on fast multiplication.
